fullPassage: Native Americans often sang and danced in preparation for launching an attack. The emotional and neurochemical excitement that resulted from this preparatory singing gave them stamina to carry out their attacks. What may have begun as an unconscious, uncontrolled act — rushing their victims with singing and beating drums in a frenzy — could have become a strategy as the victors saw firsthand the effect their actions had on those they were attacking. Although war dances risk warning an enemy of an upcoming attack, the arousal and synchronizing benefits for the attackers may compensate for the loss of surprise. Humans who sang, danced, and marched may have enjoyed a strong advantage on the battlefield as well as intimidated enemies who witnessed such a spectacle. Nineteenth-and twentieth-century Germans feared no one more than the Scots — the bagpipes and drums were disturbing in their sheer loudness and visual spectacle.

❌ ① beating drums in a frenzy — 광란 속에 북을 치는 것 (보상 대상이 아니라 공격 행위)
✅ ② the loss of surprise — 기습 상실. 적에게 경고하면 기습이 사라지므로 문맥 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ launching an attack — 공격 개시 (보상 대상이 아니라 목적)
❌ ④ a strong advantage — 강한 이점 (보상 대상이 아니라 결과)
det.tip: loss of surprise = 기습 효과의 상실

questions.passage: Native Americans often sang and danced in preparation for launching an attack. The emotional and neurochemical excitement that resulted from this preparatory singing gave them stamina to carry out their attacks. What may have begun as an unconscious, uncontrolled act — rushing their victims with singing and beating drums in a frenzy — could have become a strategy as the victors saw firsthand the effect their actions had on those they were attacking. Although war dances risk warning an enemy of an upcoming attack, the arousal and synchronizing benefits for the attackers may compensate for the loss of surprise. Humans who sang, danced, and marched may have enjoyed a strong advantage __________ as well as intimidated enemies who witnessed such a spectacle. Nineteenth-and twentieth-century Germans feared no one more than the Scots — the bagpipes and drums were disturbing in their sheer loudness and visual spectacle.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 노래하고, 춤추고, 행진한 인간들은 '전장에서' 강한 이점을 누렸을 것이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① in preparation for launching — 개시를 위한 준비로 (이점을 누린 장소가 아님)
❌ ② an upcoming attack — 다가오는 공격 (장소가 아니라 사건)
✅ ③ on the battlefield — 전장에서. 공격, 적 위협 등의 군사적 맥락 ←정답
❌ ④ in their sheer loudness — 그 엄청난 크기에서 (이점을 누린 장소가 아님)
